blacklistabilityReview.evidence: The pinned token implementation at Ethereum block 26,095,795 exposes FREEZER_ROLE-controlled freezeAccount and DEFAULT_ADMIN-controlled setBlacklisted and forceTransfer. Its _update rejects frozen or blacklisted senders, recipients, and spenders. The recorded 2-of-3 Safe currently holds DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
